text_block_list.text:
On New Year's Day, while walking through the quieter-than-usual plaza,
I bumped into Chairwoman Akikawa and Tazuna.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you!
Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out with the Chairwoman right now
to visit several shrines around the neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'd like to express my gratitude to as many gods as possible for watching over the academy every day.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Running into each other here must be fate!
You should come along too!! Hahaha!

Since it was such a great opportunity,
I decided to join them.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: We've arrived! Now, right away, the monetary offering—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh?! T-This is bad!
I don't have a single coin of change on me!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... All I have on me right now
is this card, but...!
Still... Yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'll lend it to you, so...
At any rate, after finishing our prayers, we continued touring the shrine grounds—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ――Phew. It's always so crowded here every year... but we somehow managed to finish up.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
!? Oh no!
The Chairwoman isn't here!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heeey~... Over here~!
T-The crowd is sweeping me away~... Somebody save me~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... I told you last year too, didn't I?
In places like that, it's dangerous unless you hold my hand tightly.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hrm... I thought for sure I'd challenge the no-hands ride this year, but...!
choice_data_list: Are we just heading home now?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Nay! One more spot!
There is a place Tazuna and I always visit together.

And the place we arrived at was a quaint little shrine
nestled quietly amidst the town near the academy.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Did you know about this place? It's a shrine
that hardly any of the students know about.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Even so, it would be disrespectful to the gods if no one visited the shrine right next to the academy! Thinking that, Tazuna and I have made it a tradition to come every year.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Here, we can take our time in peace
to offer our greetings to the gods. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the divine blessings, the academy was peaceful last year too.
I must be sure to pray earnestly for this year as well!

And offering a coin at the shrine,
I said a prayer for <chrname>'s dream.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then. We have visited quite a few shrines—
What did you pray to the gods for?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Asking such a thing is sheer tactlessness!
A Trainer of your caliber would obviously pray for blessings upon your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, how many years has it been
since Tazuna and I first started
visiting this shrine for New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, well now. It's been quite a long time, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hmm. When you're constantly buried in daily work, each year rushes by in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However... what we must never forget is...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
All of that represents a once-in-a-lifetime
moment for the students――
That is what it means.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You Trainers stand closest of all to them,
sharing time and supporting each other.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That sight is... simply dazzling.
So much so that I almost feel envious of you all.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Yet at the exact same time!
An overwhelming wave of joy welled up within my heart!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: As Chairwoman... I offer you all my heartfelt gratitude for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Well now, that almost sounded like closing remarks,
didn't it! Ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know what to do. Continue to give <chrname>
your full support going forward!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, return to the academy!
Tazuna made us zoni soup this morning!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We have plenty of mochi.
If you'd like, I can make whatever you prefer, whether it's sweet red bean soup or nori-wrapped mochi~
And so—together with Chairwoman Akikawa and the others, we savored the piping-hot mochi.
